text: I think you'll really enjoy this recipe because it features boneless skinless chicken breasts, which are a staple in your cooking repertoire. The combination of chicken, rice, and cheese is also a familiar and comforting one for you. The addition of green beans adds some extra nutrition and flavor, and the use of balsamic vinegar is not present, but the ingredients do include some elements that are reminiscent of your favorite recipes. This dish should take about an hour to prepare, which fits within your typical time frame for cooking.
